about.title: About SkillPass BD
about.intro: SkillPass BD gives skilled workers in Bangladesh a digital skill passport: a verified profile, a record of real jobs, and reviews from real customers.
about.workersText: Show your skills and experience, get more jobs, and build a reputation that stays with you. Everything works in Bangla with big, simple buttons.
about.customersText: Find electricians, plumbers, AC technicians and more near you. See verified jobs, structured reviews and a clear trust score before you book.
about.trustText: Every trust score shows exactly how it was calculated. Identity checks, skill evidence and confirmed jobs are shown separately.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

landing.title: Find a trusted skilled worker near you
landing.subtitle: Every worker on SkillPass BD has a verified record of real jobs and reviews from real customers.

find.title: Find
find.text: Search by service and area. Compare trust scores, verified jobs and reviews.

book.title: Book
book.text: Send a request to the worker you like. They accept and come to you.

review.title: Confirm & review
review.text: Confirm the job is done and rate the work. It becomes part of their verified history.

workerCta.title: Are you a skilled worker?
workerCta.text: Build your digital skill passport and get more jobs. It is free.

search.title: Find workers
search.emptyText: Try another area or remove some filters.

profile.noBio: This worker has not written a description yet.
profile.notFound: This worker could not be found.
profile.historyHint: Jobs confirmed by real customers on SkillPass.

trust.title: How the trust score works
trust.intro: Every worker gets a score from 0 to 100. It is built only from what happens on SkillPass, and every part is shown on the worker's profile.
trust.total: Seven parts add up to 100. The score updates after every job, review and profile change.

how.completion: Out of the jobs a worker accepted, how many they finished.
how.rating: Average customer rating. New workers start from a fair middle value until real reviews come in.
how.verified_jobs: Jobs that the customer confirmed as done. Full points at 20 confirmed jobs.
how.cancellation: How rarely the worker cancels a job after accepting it. Customer cancellations do not count.
how.response: How fast the worker answers new requests. Within 30 minutes is best.
how.identity: The worker's NID has been checked by the SkillPass team.
how.experience: Years of work experience. Full points at 10 years.

trust.confirmedText: A job only counts after the customer confirms it was done.
trust.fairStartText: New workers are not punished for having few jobs. They start from a fair middle value.
trust.notForSaleText: No one can pay to raise a score. Fake reviews are removed by our team.
